mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_adviser ( gmt_create, gmt_modify, name, phone, email, state, image_url, region_id) VALUES ( now(), now(), #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, 'ENABLED', #{imageUrl}, #{regionId});
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.gmt_create AS gmtCreate, a.name, a.phone, a.email, a.state, a.image_url AS imageUrl, a.region_id AS regionId, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.oper_userid, ''), ( SELECT au.oper_userid FROM tb_admin_user au WHERE au.adviser_id = a.id AND (au.status IS NULL OR au.status != 'DISABLED') AND au.oper_userid IS NOT NULL AND au.oper_userid != '' ORDER BY au.id DESC LIMIT 1 )) AS operUserId FROM tb_adviser a WHERE a.id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER};

SELECT id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, name, phone, email, state, image_url AS imageUrl, region_id AS regionId FROM tb_adviser WHERE region_id = #{regionId}
and state = #{state} ;
SELECT id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, name, phone, email, state, image_url AS imageUrl, region_id AS regionId , oper_userid AS operUserId FROM tb_adviser WHERE oper_userid is not null;

SELECT a.id, a.name, a.email, a.state, a.region_id AS regionId, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.oper_userid, ''), ( SELECT au.oper_userid FROM tb_admin_user au WHERE au.adviser_id = a.id AND (au.status IS NULL OR au.status != 'DISABLED') AND au.oper_userid IS NOT NULL AND au.oper_userid != '' ORDER BY au.id DESC LIMIT 1 )) AS operUserId FROM tb_adviser a WHERE a.state = 'ENABLED' HAVING operUserId IS NOT NULL AND operUserId != '' ORDER BY a.name, a.id
select id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, name, phone, email, state, image_url AS imageUrl, region_id AS regionId , oper_userid AS operUserId from tb_adviser where email = #{userName}
SELECT id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, name, phone, email, state, image_url AS imageUrl, region_id AS regionId, oper_userid AS operUserId FROM tb_adviser WHERE id IN #{id}
